metadata.value: Welcome to the OpenWeedLocator (OWL) project, an opensource hardware and software weed detector that uses entirely off-the-shelf componentry, very simple green-detection algorithms (with capacity to upgrade to in-crop detection) and 3D printable parts. OWL integrates weed detection on a Raspberry Pi with a relay control board or custom driver board, in a custom designed case so you can attach any 12V solenoid, relay, lightbulb or device for low-cost, simple and open-source site-specific weed control.
